name: Land shrimp
summary: Tôm đất is the land shrimp at chợ Cầu Hai, caught in phá Tam Giang and đầm Cầu Hai. Huế cooks it as tôm chua.
origin: Chợ Cầu Hai. The shrimp is caught in phá Tam Giang and đầm Cầu Hai.
howToEat: The Huế plate made from it is tôm chua with boiled pork and pickled bean sprouts.
where: Chợ Cầu Hai, on National Highway 1A, facing the lagoon.
seoTitle: Land shrimp at Cau Hai market
seoDescription: Tôm đất at chợ Cầu Hai is the land shrimp Huế cooks as tôm chua.
